newsitem.title: USA: Mustang Schools, Okla., $10 mln bond vote May 13.
newsitem.headline: Mustang Schools, Okla., $10 mln bond vote May 13.

text.p: Voters in Oklahoma's Mustang Public Schools district will decide on a $10 million bond issue May 13, according to Assistant Superintendent Don Snider.
Snider said $8.75 million of the offering will be used to construct a 1,000-student middle school, $500,000 will be used for furniture and $500,000 will be used for technology.
The bond issue needs 60 percent voter approval to pass.
Vote Set For School Bond Issue

(MUSTANG) -- Voters in the Mustang school district are being asked to approve a ten-Million dollar bond issue. The money is needed to build new classrooms, remodel and renovate existing facilities and buy new furnishings. A vote will be taken on May 13th.
